ability.infinity.power_stone.celestial_n: Aim a point (up to 160 blocks): colossal layered magic circles open in the sky above it, spin faster and faster and pour down a beam that annihilates everything — lethal at the centre, shockwaves, debris and a crater (only with mobGriefing). Alt+scroll: scale 1–3.
ability.infinity.power_stone.cataclysm_f: Left: start forging an orb that absorbs the surroundings (up to 4 s); left again: hurl it at the aimed point. Right: cancel. Becomes Storm, Inferno, Tide, Blizzard or Earthquake depending on the place. Alt+scroll: size 1–3.
ability.infinity.power_stone.debris_orbi: Left: tear up to 8 light copies of the ground blocks; they orbit you for 30 s and block projectiles. Left again: fire one at the aimed target. Right: fire them all.
Left: empower the aimed ally (or yourself): +30% size, Strength II and knockback immunity for 20 s. Right: turn the aimed enemy into an unstable bomb that explodes in 3 s.
ability.infinity.power_stone.seismic_wav: Left: a crest of earth races along the ground where you look and launches everything up. Right: a ring around you pushes everything outward. Alt+scroll: reach 10–30.
ability.infinity.power_stone.meteor_gate: Conjunction Power + Space. A rift opens in the sky above the aimed point and drops magma meteors one after another (10 damage each, fire). Alt+scroll: count 3–9.
ability.infinity.power_stone.convergence: Conjunction: Power + any other carried stone. Each stone becomes an orb that converges above your head and fires a braided beam at the aim. Damage grows with the stones: 2→20, 3→35, 4→55, 5→80, 6→lethal.
